strategy.thesis: Pan-European federation (network of networks) representing the early-stage / business angel investor community across Europe and beyond; advocacy, standards, data and matchmaking rather than direct investing.

summary.en: EBAN is the pan-European representative for the early stage investor community, a non-profit federation gathering business angel networks, federations, accelerators and early-stage funds. Established in 1999 with the European Commission and EURADA, it now gathers over 100 member organizations across more than 50 countries and estimates the sector it represents invests roughly EUR 11.4bn a year.
